name: Barbiecore
summary: One hot pink on everything: pink dresses, pink plastic, pink houses and glossy toy shine. Photos of a Barbie film set in 2022 started the trend, and a pink season in fashion followed.

philosophy.core_thesis: Make the whole world one pink, and play with it: toy gloss and total colour turn a doll into a dress code.
design_principles: Set the ground in hot pink (#E0218A) or pale pink (#FFE3F1) and keep pink at 60% or more of the frame.
Add one set of supports: white (#FFFFFF), sky blue (#7FD0F2) and a dark plum (#4A0F32) for text.
Set headings in a heavy, round or wide sans at 56px to 120px, tight at -0.02em, in white on pink or plum on pale pink.
Give surfaces toy gloss: a white diagonal highlight at 35% opacity and a 2px inner edge of lighter pink.
Dress one subject in head-to-toe pink, shot front-on against a matching pink wall.
Use rounded boxes of 20px to 32px, pill buttons and star or heart sparkles of 16px to 32px.
Frame products as packaging: a window box with a pink backing card and a plain price tag.

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; the hero is a pink block with a product or a figure at 45% width, and products sit in a 3-column row.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 35% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred or flush-left headings; sparkles sit at the corners of cards.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded boxes with a 24px radius, a window-box frame with a 2px white edge, and pill buttons of 999px.

font_pairings.note: A geometric sans in ExtraBold for headings; an open stand-in for the heavy toy-brand wordmark face.
A fat, friendly display face with a soft text sans.
A wide geometric sans that reads well in white on pink.

hierarchy_rules: Set headings in sentence case or upper case, in white on pink.
Set prices in a pill of 999px radius.

color.palette_structure: One hot pink with pale pink, white, sky blue and a dark plum text.
color.contrast_rules: Plum on pale pink holds 13:1; wine holds 7:1; white text sits on hot pink only at 24px or more and bold, and sky blue carries accents.
color.surface_treatment: Flat, saturated pink fills with a glossy diagonal highlight at 35% opacity; plastic-like gradients of 2 stops.
color.light_and_shadow: A bright, even light; a pink shadow of 0 12px 24px at 30% opacity; sparkles as highlights.

materiality.surface_simulation: Moulded plastic, glossy vinyl, sequins and printed card packaging.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px white inner edge on boxes; window frames with a 4px pink border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A pink-tinted shadow of 0 12px 24px at 30%; no grey shadow and no glass.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid icons at 28px with round caps in a circle tile of hot pink and white glyphs.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Pink houses, convertible cars, dresses, hearts, stars and sparkles, drawn as flat plastic shapes.

motion.transition_physics: Bright and bouncy: elements slide up by 16px with a small overshoot over 350ms; sparkles blink at 1.2s loops.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover scales a card to 103% and sweeps a gloss across it; active state scales it to 97%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels bold, playful and glad to be loud and pink.

avoid_when: The brand needs a quiet, serious or neutral tone.
The audience reads long, dense text.
The product has no link to play or fashion.

modifiers.how: Replace the hot pink with beige and warm white; keep the rounded boxes.
Add primaries, stickers and confetti, and cut the gloss.
Add chrome type, silver and baby blue, and translucent plastic.

pack.why: A filled, rounded family that matches glossy toy shapes.

ground.why: Barbiecore stands on glossy bubbles and sparkles, the shine of moulded pink plastic.
